heading.default: Your neighbourhood mini-mart, now on your phone.

default: S.Mart is a convenience store brand operated by Profitrade. We stock the everyday items people run out for: snacks, chilled and alcoholic drinks, frozen food, bakery and household essentials.
Our online shop is connected to the same POS system as our counter, so what you see in stock is what's on the shelf. Order for a delivery slot, go express, or walk in and collect.
